title: Code Agent Error Output — Halt Envelope
description: Written to agent-output/CodeAgent-Output/<TICKET>.code.error.json — a DIFFERENT file than the success output (<TICKET>.code.json) — whenever Code Agent halts before producing real file operations: either its input didn't validate against design-output.schema.json (AC #9), or its own attempted success output failed Ajv validation against code-output.schema.json (AC #11). Using a separate filename means a halt never overwrites the last known-good <TICKET>.code.json that Test Agent may still be relying on. This shape is NEVER validated against code-output.schema.json, and code-output.schema.json is never validated against this one — they are two unrelated schemas for two unrelated files, not a oneOf split of one file.

error.description: One-line summary of what halted the run, e.g. "Input design plan failed schema validation" or "Generated output failed Ajv validation against code-output.schema.json".

details.description: Optional: the specific violations — e.g. one Ajv error string per entry, or one missing/mismatched newArtifacts[] path per entry. Omit or leave empty if error alone is sufficiently specific.
